method.T: Synthetic B44 B-inspired eastward slope extended to full continent, RECENTERED by changing x-origin from 1120 to 540 and offsetting raw elevations. Not identical to B44 field. Does not use river mouths to create relief.
method.O: Synthetic oblique highlands from positive Gaussian lobes at (1160,322),(1430,525),(1310,525),(820,410), and negative lowland lobes at (1060,600),(1080,475), plus mild east trend and waves. Coordinates do not signify a measured mountain or fault.
method.fill: Priority-flood from polygon-0 coastline land cells, raising isolated pits by 0.0015 dimensionless units; changes explicitly counted.
method.routing: D8 steepest descent to first pixel outside polygon 0, which is treated as zero altitude. The other 98 land polygons are not checked, so OTHER_COAST is a land-mask exit, NOT verified open sea.
method.terminal: Sea-mask exit pixel is labeled R1 or R2 only if within 45 drawing units of the matching B43 schematic mouth; otherwise OTHER_COAST. Proximity is not actual drainage proof.
method.cropping: All of polygon 0 is surrounded by grid margin, replacing B44 partial east-coast window. The 2403 old domain-edge B44 B cells are remapped to the closest B45 cell and reclassified under new terrains, not original B44 flow.
limitations: Entire polygon 0 is a B42 candidate, not accepted world coordinates.
Relief is dimensionless, synthetic, and has no geological or hydrometeorological observations.
Flood filling suppresses internally closed basins by design and should not be read as proof that no lakes exist.
A coastal contact outside polygon 0 can be another land polygon, not necessarily ocean.
D8 raster artifacts and grid resolution affect apparent tributary and catchment shape.
No R1/R2 river source, course, watershed, rainfall, sediment input or national geography is canonized.
